title: 2248. Intersection of Multiple Arrays

examples.explanation: The only integers present in each of nums[0] = [3,1,2,4,5], nums[1] = [1,2,3,4], and nums[2] = [3,4,5,6] are 3 and 4, so we return [3,4].
There does not exist any integer present both in nums[0] and nums[1], so we return an empty list [].
